title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.29954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. translated_title: Yggdrasil（世界树）：用于状态跟踪与快速CPU推理的树路由循环专家
translated_abstract: 可并行训练的循环结构（如Mamba、线性注意力、DeltaNet）能够提供恒定代价的流式推理，但它们存在两个局限：1）难以跟踪离散状态；2）在每一步都需要读取所有参数，使模型容量直接与CPU延迟绑定。我们提出了Yggdrasil，这是一种循环架构，通过在庞大的树路由循环专家库中查找每一层的转移函数，将模型容量与每步计算解耦。每个路由器使用当前token以及下一层的状态来寻址其专家库。我们证明了这种跨层上下文是必要的——单一token索引的、具有有限个可达状态的非扩展转移层无法执行条件重置——同时，避免来自该层自身过去的反馈则保留了并行扫描训练。由于每一步只遍历一条树路径，且每层只读取单个专家，活跃权重保持在几百……
tldr: Yggdrasil通过树路由的循环专家库将模型容量与每步计算解耦，既能跟踪离散状态，又能在CPU上实现快速推理。
en_tdlr: Yggdrasil is a recurrent architecture that decouples model capacity from per-step compute via tree-routed banks of recurrent experts, enabling both discrete state tracking and fast CPU inference.
